title: Recruitment of Mre11 to recombination sites during meiosis
authors: Priyadarshini P; Survi M; Yazidi Mouloud WE; Bohn R; Ballet S; Hunter N; Volkov AN; Bouuaert CC
one_liner_zh: 该文研究减数分裂中Mre11蛋白通过IDR和相分离被招募至DNA双链断裂位点的机制，涉及蛋白质-DNA互作但非TF-DNA体系，且无AI或物理模拟方法，仅湿实验，故评分为5。
abstract: The Mre11 nuclease, part of the conserved MRX complex involved in the repair of DNA double-strand breaks (DSBs), is also essential to initiate meiotic recombination in budding yeast by promoting Spo11-induced DSBs. Recruitment of Mre11 to meiotic DSB sites depends on Rec114-Mei4 and Mer2 (RMM) that organize the meiotic DSB machinery by a mechanism involving biomolecular condensation. Here, we explored the role of Mre11 during meiosis and its relationship to RMM condensation. We show that both Mre11 and MRX complexes form DNA-dependent, hexanediol sensitive condensates in vitro. In vivo , Mre11 assembles into DNA damage-dependent foci in vegetative cells and DSB-independent foci in meiotic cells. In vitro condensates and in vivo foci both depend on the C-terminal intrinsically-disordered region (IDR) of Mre11. Importantly, while the Mre11 IDR is dispensable for vegetative DNA repair it is essential during meiosis. The C-terminus of Mre11 forms a short α-helix that binds a conserved region of Mer2, and mutating residues within this interface reduces Mre11 foci and DSB formation. Finally, we identified a SUMO-interacting motif within the Mre11 IDR that enhances recruitment of Mre11 during meiosis and facilitates DSB formation. This work identifies multiple mechanisms that collaborate to recruit Mre11 during meiosis to initiate recombination.
abstract_zh: Mre11核酸酶是保守的MRX复合物的一部分，参与DNA双链断裂（DSBs）的修复，同时对于芽殖酵母中通过促进Spo11诱导的DSBs来启动减数分裂重组也至关重要。Mre11向减数分裂DSB位点的募集依赖于Rec114-Mei4和Mer2（RMM），这些蛋白通过涉及生物分子凝聚（biomolecular condensation）的机制组织减数分裂DSB机制。在此，我们探讨了Mre11在减数分裂中的作用及其与RMM凝聚的关系。我们表明，Mre11和MRX复合物在体外均形成依赖于DNA的、对己二醇敏感的凝聚体。在体内，Mre11在营养细胞中组装成依赖于DNA损伤的焦点，在减数分裂细胞中组装成不依赖于DSB的焦点。体外凝聚体和体内焦点均依赖于Mre11的C端内在无序区域（IDR）。重要的是，虽然Mre11 IDR对于营养细胞DNA修复是非必需的，但在减数分裂中却是必需的。Mre11的C端形成一个短α-螺旋，结合Mer2的保守区域，并且该界面内残基的突变会减少Mre11焦点和DSB形成。最后，我们在Mre11 IDR内识别出一个SUMO相互作用基序，该基序增强减数分裂期间Mre11的募集并促进DSB形成。这项工作识别了多种协同机制，在减数分裂期间募集Mre11以启动重组。
